# Mitigate @azure/msal-node advisory (Dependabot #201)

## Context

The advisory affects `@azure/msal-node` >= 5.0.0-beta.0, < 7.1.0 (auth_code flow; patched in 7.1.0).
Dependabot can't open a PR because one dependency chain pins an incompatible range.

Findings (from `eval/package-lock.json`):

- The package appears only in the `eval/` tree, as a dev and optional dependency of `promptfoo@0.125.0`.
  It is not in the root tree and not in the Lambda asset (`lib/rss_lambda_stack.ts` excludes `eval`).
  It is installed only by `.github/workflows/eval.yml`. The flow isn't used here (no MSAL auth_code usage), so real risk is very low.
- Two vulnerable copies:
  - top-level `7.0.1`, from `promptfoo` (`^7.0.0`). Not blocked: `^7.0.0` already allows 7.1.x.
  - nested `@azure/identity/node_modules/@azure/msal-node` `6.0.1`, from `@azure/identity@4.13.3` (`^6.0.0`).
    This is the blocked copy. Latest stable `@azure/identity` is 4.14.0 and still declares `^6.0.0`.
    `@azure/ai-projects` 2.9.0 also still uses identity `^4.13.0`.

## Plan

1. Top-level copy: in `eval/`, run `npm update @azure/msal-node` → lockfile moves 7.0.1 to 7.1.1.
   verify: `npm --prefix eval ls @azure/msal-node` shows 7.1.1 for the top-level entry.
2. Nested 6.0.1 copy: add `"@azure/msal-node": "^7.1.0"` to `eval/package.json` `overrides`, alongside the existing pins, then `npm --prefix eval install`.
   This forces identity onto 7.x, which identity doesn't declare support for, so check it works.
   verify: every `@azure/msal-node` entry in `eval/package-lock.json` is >= 7.1.0; `npm --prefix eval ls @azure/identity` has no `invalid` flags.
3. Smoke check the eval still loads: `npm --prefix eval exec promptfoo -- --version`, and a dry run of the eval config if one exists.
   The Azure providers are optional and unused, so breakage is unlikely.
   verify: command exits 0. If it breaks, drop the override and fall back to option B.
4. Commit as `fix(deps): override @azure/msal-node to patched 7.1.x in eval`, on a branch, and open a PR so CI (`eval.yml`/lint) confirms. Dependabot alert should auto-close once main has the lockfile.

## Fallbacks

- B: If the override breaks identity, do step 1 only and dismiss the remaining alert for the nested 6.0.1 copy as "not used / dev-only, no auth_code flow", then retry when `@azure/identity` ships msal-node 7 support.
- Dependabot has no ignore rules, so no config change is needed. The `eval-dependencies` group will pick up identity's fix later.

## Critical files

- `eval/package.json` (add override)
- `eval/package-lock.json` (regenerated)

## Verification

- `npm --prefix eval ls @azure/msal-node` → all >= 7.1.0
- `npm --prefix eval audit` → no msal-node advisory
- CI green on PR; Dependabot alert #201 closes after merge
